headlines.title: Trump’s AG pick scraps ‘anti-weaponization’ fund in deal with holdout senators
headlines.description: The Senate Judiciary Committee is set to hold a vote to advance Blanche’s nomination Tuesday.

headlines.title: Former Texas Rep. Kay Granger dies at 83
headlines.description: Republican former Rep. Kay Granger of Texas has died, lawmakers announced Sunday.

headlines.title: Govs. Kevin Stitt and Wes Moore call for bringing ‘dignity’ back to government
headlines.description: Stitt and Moore said social media contributes to negativity and polarization in politics and urged more in-person connections.

headlines.title: Sen. Bernie Moreno says former son-in-law Max Miller shouldn’t serve in Congress following abuse allegations
headlines.description: Rep. Max Miller, R-Ohio, denied allegations that he abused the senator’s daughter and chastised him for speaking out.

headlines.title: Blanche Scraps ‘Anti-Weaponization’ Fund Ahead of Nomination
headlines.description: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche’s nomination appears to be back on track after he announced a key decision to satisfy two Republican holdouts in the Senate who said they could not support his confirmation until the “anti-weaponization” fund was rescinded in writing. Now, Blanche posted an order establishing, “Beyond any doubt, there is no fund.” NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Says Iran Talks to Resume After Strikes Called off
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced the United States and Iran are set to resume talks following his decision to call off massive strikes over the weekend. There’s no confirmation from Iran but Iran’s foreign minister did say, “Negotiations are on the path to being finalized.” NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Wes Moore & Kevin Stitt say civility can win general elections, but primaries are the problem
headlines.description: Gov. Wes Moore (D-Md.), Gov. Kevin Stitt (R-Okla.) and Unite CEO Tim Shriver join Kristen Welker for a Common Ground conversation on dignity in politics, live from the National Governors Association event in Oklahoma City.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Rep. Marcy Kaptur hospitalized after hit-and-run car crash
headlines.description: A spokesperson said Kaptur, D-Ohio, is alert and being treated for non-life-threatening injuries.

headlines.title: Sen. John Kennedy says he’d exclude Jan. 6 rioters from an ‘anti-weaponization’ fund bill
headlines.description: Sen. John Kennedy, R-La., told NBC News’ “Meet the Press” he would’nt provide the Trump administration with a “blank check” for the proposed “anti-weaponization” fund.

headlines.title: Truth Social launches service selling faster access to Trump posts
headlines.description: Wall Street firms can now be alerted of the “most market-moving” social media posts from President Donald Trump before the general public — as long as they pay the right price.

headlines.title: Trump rebukes Jeanine Pirro over decision to drop Reflecting Pool vandalism case
headlines.description: President Donald Trump criticized longtime ally Jeanine Pirro Saturday after she agreed to drop a case against a former Olympic canoeist who was accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.
